_schema_notes: Coordinates and hours sourced from live Google Maps listings on 2026-07-11. Google hours can lag reality — spot-check in person when convenient. hours: 24h 'HH:MM-HH:MM' per day, null = closed that day. Whole hours object null = hours unknown/unconfirmed. Closing past midnight: 02:00 am = '26:00', 03:00 am = '27:00'. hours_note: shown instead of 'hours unconfirmed' when hours is null but there's a known reason (e.g. a venue with no daily schedule) rather than nobody having looked — only read when hours is null. photos (and events.json's photo field): '<version>/<publicId>', e.g. 'v1785599071/anfront_ycq5p6' — a Cloudinary public ID, not a full URL. See cloudinaryUrl() in js/app.js, the only place that turns this into a delivery URL (cloud name + q_auto,f_auto,dpr_auto + width live there, not in the stored value). vibe: 0-4 tags from a fixed vocabulary (quiet, lively, alone-ok, cheap — see VIBE_TAGS in functions/api/_venue-validation.js), Kar-set only. Omitted/null = not yet tagged.

venues.name: Kong View
venues.short: Riverside-view restaurant and bar with live music
venues.description: Big open-air restaurant and bar on Souphanouvong Road with a view across the Mekong to Thailand. Known for live bands in the evening, Beerlao on tap and grilled food. Fills up with groups after sunset.

venues.name: Chokdee Café Belgian Beer Bar
venues.short: Belgian beer bar on the riverfront, big bottle list
venues.description: Belgian beer institution on the riverfront with one of the biggest bottle lists in Laos, regular 2-for-1 deals and pub food. Casual, popular with both locals and expats.

venues.name: Café Sinouk Khemkhong
venues.name_lo: ຄາເຟຊີນຸກ ເຂື່ອນຂອງ
venues.area: Quai Fa Ngum, opposite the night market
venues.short: Lao coffee house on the riverfront
venues.description: Riverside branch of the Lao coffee roaster, opposite the night market. Lao-grown beans, pastries and breakfast. Good daytime meeting spot before the riverfront wakes up.

venues.name: ITECC
venues.short: Mall and exhibition halls, hosts concerts and events
venues.description: Vientiane's main hall for concerts, fairs and big events. Check the event listing for dates — the building itself is a mall during the day.
venues.hours_note: Opens for events — check the listing

venues.name: Go Dunk
venues.short: Temporarily closed after a fire — rebuilding bigger, back soon
venues.description: Vintage-garage bar-restaurant with burgers, pizza and nightly live music — temporarily closed after a fire, using the moment to rebuild wider and better. Follow their page for the reopening. It'll be a big night.

venues.name: Status Restaurant & Bar
venues.short: The late-night spot of the moment
venues.description: Restaurant-bar next door to Go Dunk that picked up the late-night crowd while its neighbour rebuilds. Live bands nightly — The Late play the early set daily, Felicia X VIP take the weekend — with acoustic, hiphop and DJ sets through the night. Table booking: 020 5236 6087.
venues.source: Google Maps listing, 2026-07-11 (hours not listed there); hours from an in-person visit — approximate, not confirmed directly with the venue

venues.name: Rustic White 90's Music Bar
venues.short: 90s music bar with live folk sets and DJ
venues.description: Music bar built around 90s hits, live folk sets and a DJ. Draws a young crowd — going early gets you a seat. Best with a group.

venues.name: Baron Vientiane
venues.short: Cocktail and DJ lounge, 90s and 2000s pop
venues.description: Upstairs cocktail lounge with DJ sets leaning 90s and 2000s pop. Dressier and pricier than the average Vientiane bar — bottle service for tables — with a big-city club feel. Closed Tuesdays, open late on weekends.

venues.name: Mahasan Music & Bar
venues.area: 2nd floor area above Starbucks, same building as Baron
venues.short: Live band and DJ bar
venues.description: Live music bar with bands and a DJ, decorated interior, food worth trying. Friendly to both locals and visitors.
venues.source: Google Maps listing 2026-07-11, location confirmed in person

venues.name: Treekoff Watchane
venues.name_lo: ທຣີຄອຟ ວັດຈັນ
venues.area: Khun Bu Lom Rd, opposite Wat Chan
venues.short: Affordable specialty coffee, often a queue
venues.description: Small, popular coffee shop opposite the temple on Khun Bu Lom Road. Affordable, good beans, cozy wooden upstairs that fills fast — expect a queue at peak hours.

venues.name: Tree Town Cafe
venues.short: Photo-friendly decor, bingsu and cotton-candy lattes
venues.description: The photo-spot café — seasonal decor, cotton-candy-topped lattes, beanbags upstairs and well-known bingsu. Tucked in a small soi off Chao Anou. Closed Mondays.

venues.name: Common Grounds Cafe & Bakery
venues.name_lo: ຄອມມອນກຣາວ
venues.short: Brunch café and bakery near the night market
venues.description: Long-running café and bakery on Chao Anou — pita pockets, salads, baked goods and strong coffee, with a small shop inside. A daytime staple near the night market. Closed Sundays.

venues.name: Drip 1920s
venues.short: Vintage 1920s-theme café, open late Thu–Sun
venues.description: Retro café styled to the 1920s — gramophone music, vintage decor, drip coffee blends — inside a hostel garden. Unusually for a Vientiane café, it stays open until midnight Thursday to Sunday.

venues.name: MaoMao Matcha Café
venues.name_lo: ເມົາເມົາ ມັດຈະ
venues.short: Small ceremonial-grade matcha café
venues.description: Compact matcha specialist near That Luang — ceremonial-grade matcha, strawberry daifuku, calm vibe. Closes mid-afternoon, so it's a daytime stop. Closed Saturdays.

venues.name: Vientiane Night Market (riverside)
venues.name_lo: ຕະຫຼາດກາງຄືນ
venues.short: Riverside tents — clothes, souvenirs, crafts
venues.description: The nightly riverside market at Chao Anouvong Park — red-tent stalls with clothes, souvenirs and crafts. Busiest Friday and Saturday evenings, when street performers often join. A standing anchor of the riverfront night. The food stalls are a separate market across the road — don't come to these tents expecting dinner.

venues.name: Night Street
venues.area: Mekong boardwalk, near the King Anouvong statue — exact spot needs confirming
venues.short: Open-air night zone on the riverbank — music, beer and food stalls
venues.description: Open-air nightlife zone on the Mekong boardwalk that took over from the old Cowboy Park — beer and finger-food stalls with a young local crowd, reportedly with free live music on busy nights. No official listing; location approximate.
venues.source: TripAdvisor reports 2026 + boardwalk coordinates estimated — confirm location and schedule in person

venues.name: Farsai Cafe & Restaurant
venues.name_lo: ຟ້າໃສ ຄາເຟ
venues.short: Cafe-restaurant with garden seating, hosts meetups
venues.description: Cafe and restaurant inside the National Library compound with a spacious interior and outdoor garden seating. Fresh, well-priced food — and an occasional venue for community meetups and tech events.

venues.name: Corebeer Brewery
venues.short: Craft brewery — Thursday meetup night
venues.description: Vientiane's craft brewery — kölsch, IPAs and stouts brewed on site, cozy low-lit taproom. Hosts the big Make Friends + language exchange meetup every Thursday evening. The town's best answer to one-more-Beerlao fatigue.

venues.name: Parkson (Naga Mall)
venues.short: Mall — events, food court, cinema crowd
venues.description: The big air-conditioned mall on Khouvieng — shops, food court, kids' zone, and a regular stage for contests and brand events.

venues.name: KOKKOK Mega Mall Patuxay
venues.name_lo: ກົກກົກ ເມກາມໍ
venues.short: Laos' first lifestyle mall — 70+ brands by Patuxay
venues.description: Laos' first lifestyle mega mall, opened 8 August 2026. Built by Kolao Group with Grandview Property, about 500m from Patuxay at the junction opposite ICBC. 70+ international brands, heavy on Thai and Korean names, across four zones: dining, retail, an entertainment floor with kids' attractions, photo spots and gaming, and a services floor with banking, beauty and electronics.
venues.source: Facebook page KokKokMegaMall + kokkokmegamall.com; opening confirmed 2026-08-08; hours from their Facebook page, updated by the venue 2026-08-08

parking.note: Three zones — motorbikes at B on the main road, cars A or C

venues.name: MADAME Cocktail Bar
venues.short: Speakeasy cocktail bar
venues.description: Hidden cocktail bar on the 8th floor of the Lao Poet Hotel — through a curtain and a padded door into a 1930s speakeasy. House-infused spirits, local ingredients, small plates. One of the highest-rated bars in the city.

venues.name: Tipsy Elephant Rooftop Lounge
venues.name_lo: ທິບຊີ ເອເລແຟນ
venues.short: Rooftop sunset spot, happy hour 5–7
venues.description: Rooftop lounge with a wide view over the city and the Mekong. Happy hour 5–7pm on selected drinks. Popular for sunset — the wall seats go early.

venues.name: Stellar Bar
venues.short: Highest rooftop in town, Mekong views
venues.description: Rooftop bar on the 15th floor of the Amari — the widest sunset view in Vientiane, out over the Mekong to the fields on the Thai side, with the night market below. Cocktail-led.

venues.name: The Blues Box
venues.name_lo: ບລູສ໌ ບັອກ
venues.short: Live jazz and blues — look for the red saxophone
venues.description: Small live-music bar tucked off Pangkham — look for the red saxophone on the facade. Jazz nights, live bands, Latin dance on Thursdays, and cocktails people cross town for. Closed Mondays.

venues.name: Wind West
venues.short: Late live music, 9pm till 2am
venues.description: Long-running live music pub on Khun Bu Lom — fairy lights, mismatched furniture, a house band that plays covers to a crowd that knows every word. Opens late and runs to 2am. Come for the music.

venues.name: 7th Heaven
venues.name_lo: ເຊເວັນເຮເວັນ
venues.short: Rooftop dining over the Mekong
venues.description: Seventh-floor rooftop restaurant on the riverfront — sunset over the Mekong, Lao and western food, live music some weekend evenings. Booking advised; it fills with groups.

venues.name: Sathiti Café
venues.name_lo: ສະຖິຕິ ກາເຟ
venues.short: Competition-winning coffee, open from 7am
venues.description: Specialty coffee house on Hengboun run by a competition barista — Champion of the Savannakhet Aeropress 2025 and third in the Vientiane Moka Pot Battle. Almond croissants, sandwiches and Lao-Thai plates alongside the coffee, and rooms upstairs if you never leave.
venues.source: Facebook page + Google Maps listing (phone matches both), 2026-07-26

venues.name: Anthophile
venues.short: Flower shop, café and workshop rooms — closed Mondays
venues.description: Anthophile means a person who loves flowers, and the place is built around that — a café in the middle of a courtyard with rooms for pottery, baking classes and floral arranging around it. Fresh flowers for sale and you can put your own bouquet together. Still in soft opening, and it shows: the food gets the praise, the coffee is finding its feet. Worth the trip east if you want an afternoon rather than a quick coffee.
venues.source: Facebook page + Google Maps listing, phone matches both, 2026-07-28

venues.name: Sunin Restaurant & Cafe
venues.name_lo: ສຸນິນຄາເຟ່
venues.source: Owner-submitted; location confirmed against Google Maps 2026-08-07
